outcome_range.note: Quoted from the perspective of Miami Dolphins, off the engine’s own learned margin distribution (conditioned on this spread, so real key-number mass is kept). Eight results in ten land inside p10–p90.

model.confidence_absent_reason: The NFL model publishes no single confidence score. What it publishes instead is the width of the outcome range above and the sample the ratings rest on: the trained seeds through 2025, plus 106 absorbed 2026 games.

model.validation: UNPROVEN — this model does NOT beat the closing line out of sample. Research only; nothing here is graded as a bet.

key_number.text: Market sits on 7; model is above 7.
key_number.detail: New England Patriots: market −7.0, model fair −8.0.
key_number.note: Key margins are where football games often finish. How often differs between the NFL and college football; this note marks where the two lines sit and does not change any probability.

market.total_rounding_note: Fair lines rounded to nearest half-point; differences use unrounded projections.

market.note: EdgeDesk compares its own number with a captured price. The comparison is a research state, not a bet — and out of sample this model does not beat the close.

games.market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at DraftKings and Caesars on 2026-09-10, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live.
